renderer_denied_operations.reason: ADR-0019 and ADR-0037 require React to use a closed host mapping and prohibit a direct coordinator connection.
The field carries internal orchestration instructions; WP4 must replace renderer reachability with a typed user-run request.
The current request carries validated absolute setup paths and adapter inputs; later renderer setup uses typed native workflows, never this raw application shape.
renderer_denied_operations.retained_consumer: native application/setup orchestration and integration harnesses

renderer_denied_operations.reason: These are backend/CLI diagnostic and retained-artifact surfaces. WP5 must supply bounded user-meaningful projections rather than expose storage-oriented identities or whole output payloads.
renderer_denied_operations.retained_consumer: CLI, native diagnostics, and integration harnesses

renderer_denied_operations.reason: The declared shapes expose operational/accounting identities and are currently unimplemented. Later UI status requires a non-secret presentation projection with separate authority.

renderer_denied_operations.reason: Credential enrollment must remain helper-owned and WPF-parented under ADR-0020; the current declared command is not a renderer-safe choreography and is unimplemented.
A renderer can never submit provider request bytes, operation identities, pricing/budget inputs, or dispatch authority. Provider operations remain coordinator/helper internal.
